changeLogMessages: The updated Standard retry behavior is now the default: transient errors are retried with shorter backoff, and throttling errors consume less retry quota. HTTP 429 responses without a recognized error code are now retried as throttling errors. DynamoDB and DynamoDB Streams clients now default to 3 retries (previously 10) unless AWS_MAX_ATTEMPTS, max_attempts or MaxErrorRetry is set. The AWS_NEW_RETRIES_2026 environment variable is no longer used.
